resources.string:
This is an Android app for detecting lanes on a road using a camera, working best on highways. The code processes the video frames captured by the camera and identifies the lanes by applying image processing and AI techniques. 

The app uses OpenCV and TensorFlow Lite for computer vision and deep learning inference. It processes input frames, masks the region of interest, and predicts driving lane boundaries. 

The detected lanes are analyzed to estimate distance from vehicle center to lane edges. 

The scale parameter can be adjusted in real time to convert pixel measurements to physical meters.
